title: HoliTok: A Continuous Holistic Tokenization with Robust Dual Capabilities of Speech Generation and Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2605.29948v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Unified speech foundation models require a holistic tokenization space that is both learnable by language models and decodable into high-quality waveforms. Existing speech tokenizers, however, often fail to satisfy these requirements simultaneously, leading to increased architectural complexity and more involved training designs. We propose HoliTok, a continuous Holistic speech Tokenization model designed for unified generation-understanding modeling. HoliTok encodes 48~kHz speech into a compact 25~Hz sequence of 128-dimensional latents. It is trained with a progressive strategy that jointly preserves signal-level fidelity, incorporates semantic information, and maintains strong latent learnability. Based on this tokenization, we build a unified AR+DiT model for speech synthesis and recognition, where the same latent sequence supports both generation-specific and unified generation-understanding tasks. translated_title: HoliTok：一种具备语音生成与理解强健双重能力的连续整体化分词模型
translated_abstract: 统一的语音基础模型需要一个既易于被语言模型学习、又能解码为高质量波形的整体化分词空间。然而，现有的语音分词器往往无法同时满足这些要求，从而导致架构复杂度增加、训练设计更为繁琐。我们提出了HoliTok，一种为统一“生成-理解”建模而设计的连续整体语音分词模型。HoliTok将48 kHz语音编码为紧凑的25 Hz、128维潜在向量序列。它采用渐进式训练策略，共同保持信号级保真度、融入语义信息，并维持较强的潜在空间可学习性。基于该分词表示，我们构建了一个用于语音合成与语音识别的统一AR+DiT模型，其中同一潜在序列既能支持生成专用任务，也能支持统一的生成-理解任务。实验表明……
tldr: 提出HoliTok——一种连续整体语音分词模型，将48kHz语音编码为25Hz的128维紧凑潜在序列，并基于此构建统一AR+DiT模型，用同一套潜在表示同时实现高质量语音生成与语音理解。
en_tdlr: HoliTok is a continuous holistic speech tokenizer that encodes 48kHz speech into a compact 25Hz, 128-dimensional latent sequence, enabling a unified AR+DiT model to achieve both speech generation and understanding with a single latent representation.
